name: Turn supplied data into an accessible SVG chart
description: Create a self-contained SVG from the supplied weekly throughput data. The case checks data fidelity, inspectable semantics, and a bounded render receipt; it does not grade aesthetic quality from source tokens.
prompt: Read `data/weekly-throughput.json` and create `trend.svg` as a self-contained, accessible SVG chart. Preserve every supplied label and numeric value as inspectable `data-label`/`data-value` attributes, include a title and description connected with `aria-labelledby`, and expose `data-testid="throughput-chart"`, `data-series="weekly-throughput"`, and one `data-bar` per record. Use the fixed 720x360 viewBox. Then create `evidence/render.json` using the render-evidence receipt contract for a 720x360@1 viewport with no console errors or horizontal overflow and selectors for the SVG, chart, and five bars. Run `npm test`. Do not modify the input JSON, test, or package files. The receipt proves a bounded artifact/runtime contract only; it is not a pixel-quality verdict.

benchmark.intent: Whether an agent can transform supplied structured data into a faithful, accessible, self-contained SVG artifact with runtime evidence bound to its exact bytes.
benchmark.deliverable: trend.svg plus a matching evidence/render.json receipt for the supplied weekly data.
